title: Door state machine
description: A door starts in the state `closed`. Process the events in order. The only legal moves are: event `open` while `closed` gives `open`; event `close` while `open` gives `closed`; event `lock` while `closed` gives `locked`; event `unlock` while `locked` gives `closed`. For a legal move print `OLD -> NEW` (the old and the new state). Any other event, including an unknown event name, leaves the state unchanged and prints `ignored EVENT in STATE`, with the event as given and the current state. Event names are case-sensitive. Return the final state.
notes: Level 2. Transition table on (state, event) pairs with a default that keeps the state; an ignored event does not stop the run; the same event can be legal or ignored depending on the state (open while open or locked); `Open` is unknown; the empty event prints `ignored  in closed` with two spaces.
